tiers.label: Free / Basic
tiers.promise: Start with a chart-first workspace and learn the market without a paid subscription.

poster.title: START WITH THE CHART
poster.subtitle: Free Basic access · Learn without the noise
poster.alt: ClearPath Trader Free Basic poster: Start with the chart. Free Basic access and chart-first education.

videos.hook: What if your trading screen started with the chart instead of the noise?
beats: Cut to the ClearPath Basic chart
Show five indicators and simple drawing tools
End on the free Basic offer
videos.voiceover: ClearPath Basic keeps the chart first. Start with essential indicators, drawing tools, watchlists, and plain-English education—free.

videos.hook: Your first chart lesson should not feel like a casino.
beats: Explain price, time, and volume in three labels
Invite the viewer to continue learning
videos.voiceover: Price, time, and volume come before predictions. ClearPath Basic pairs a clean chart with free educational references so you can learn what you are seeing.

tiers.label: Silver
tiers.promise: Build a larger learning workspace with intraday charts, replay, education, and customization.

poster.title: BUILD YOUR WORKSPACE
poster.subtitle: Four charts · Replay · Education · More control
poster.alt: ClearPath Trader Silver poster: Build your workspace with four charts, replay, education, and customization.

videos.hook: One market rarely tells the whole story.
videos.voiceover: Silver expands the workspace to four charts and adds intraday views, market replay, education, and customization. More context without losing the chart.

videos.hook: Pause the market. Rewind the lesson.
videos.voiceover: Market replay lets you study completed price action without pretending you knew the outcome. Silver combines replay, drawing tools, and education for deliberate practice.

tiers.label: Gold
tiers.promise: Study chart patterns and bring your own indicator logic into a ten-chart workspace.

poster.title: SEE THE PATTERN. LEARN THE STRUCTURE.
poster.subtitle: Pattern Overlay · INDACREATOR · Ten-chart workspace
poster.alt: ClearPath Trader Gold poster: Learn chart structure with Pattern Overlay, INDACREATOR, and a ten-chart workspace.

videos.hook: A pattern label is not a trade signal. It is a lesson in structure.
videos.voiceover: Gold can mark supported chart patterns on the chart you are already reading. Use the overlay to study structure—not as a promise or prediction.

videos.hook: Bring indicator logic you already wrote into your ClearPath chart.
videos.voiceover: INDACREATOR interprets supported Pine-style indicator logic on ClearPath charts. Results may differ from another platform, but your learning and experimentation stay in one workspace.

tiers.label: Platinum
tiers.promise: Bring the complete workspace together with the AI Pattern Scanner and supported automation tools.

poster.title: SCAN FOR STRUCTURE. VERIFY ON THE CHART.
poster.subtitle: AI Pattern Scanner · Complete ClearPath workspace
poster.alt: ClearPath Trader Platinum poster: Scan for chart structure and verify it on the chart with the AI Pattern Scanner.

videos.hook: Scanning is the beginning of analysis—not the end.
videos.voiceover: Platinum uses the AI Pattern Scanner to surface supported pattern candidates. You still inspect the chart, study the structure, and make your own decisions.

videos.hook: Charts, education, patterns, and your tools—together.
beats: Move through the four trader desks
videos.voiceover: Platinum brings the ClearPath workspace together: charts, indicators, replay, education, Pattern Overlay, INDACREATOR, and the AI Pattern Scanner. Educational tools—not financial advice.
